description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK and MAG +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)]/[ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)] to all allies with 0-3/4+ Knight allies in the party, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Pride Mode I: Angeal v2] and [(Wind/Holy) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Pride Mode I: Angeal v2
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Wind and Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Holy)] and [Dual Awoken Pride Mode II: Angeal v2] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Pride Mode II: Angeal v2
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Wind and Holy abilities, casts Dual Entrusted Pride after using a Wind or Holy ability (max 1)

description.name: Dual Entrusted Pride
description.text: Grants [Buff Wind 20% (15s)] and [Buff Holy 20% (15s)] to all allies

description.name: Buff Wind 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable
